about.description: A fast, beautiful cache and junk cleaner for Linux. It scans well-known cache, log and leftover locations of browsers, developer tools, apps and games, including Flatpak and Snap apps, then lets you decide what goes.
about.safety.desc: Only files underneath scanned locations are ever touched. System folders, your home folder, Documents, Downloads and your other personal folders are hard-blocked. Trash mode is on by default.
